characters.name: Ada
characters.personality: Unflappable, dry, solves it with clicks before anyone finishes panicking. Never seen without her mug.
gags: Fixes things with clicks while others are still writing code

characters.name: Dex
characters.personality: Brilliant and over-eager. Would rather write 300 lines of Apex than tick a checkbox, and learns limits the hard way.
gags: Reaches for code when a setting would do
Trips a limit and gets whistled at by Gus

characters.name: Archie
characters.personality: Calm and professorial. Draws a diagram for everything and answers most questions with 'it depends'.
gags: Produces a whiteboard out of nowhere

characters.name: Penny
characters.personality: Cheerful, impatient, full of ideas. Wants everything by Friday and calls every request 'a quick one'.
gags: Calls a huge request 'just a quick one'

characters.name: Bolt
characters.personality: A small helpful robot who takes every instruction completely literally and is proud of it.
gags: Announces what it is about to do before doing it

characters.name: Gus
characters.personality: A fair but relentless referee who appears the instant anyone crosses a platform limit. Blows the whistle, never explains twice.
gags: Blows the whistle the moment a limit is hit
